  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
  • Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouse, and embedded analytics ecosystem.

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design backend patterns supporting large-scale, automated reporting workloads
  • Implement caching, pagination, and batching strategies for high-volume, concurrent
  • analytics requests

  • where necessary
  • Contribute to system design documentation, endpoint versioning, and architecture diagrams
  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code definitions (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability and monitoring via CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Platform teams to ensure APIs align with data contracts and warehouse schemas
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define API requirements and roadmap priorities
  • Participate in technical design reviews, security audits, and postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, and developer experience


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in a modern web stack
  • Proficiency in PHP (Laminas, Symfony, Laravel), Node.js, or Python for backend service development
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale
  • Hands-on experience integrating data warehouse APIs (Redshift, Snowflake) or analytics services (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Solid understanding of multi-tenant authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices

title: Salesforce Apex Developer
description:
Salesforce Apex Developer

Location : Brazil

We are looking a seasoned Salesforce engineer, who designs, develops, and optimizes secure, scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL/SOSL.

Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and unit-test Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueables, schedulables, and platform events in multi-org environments.

· Build modern UIs with LWC/Aura, integrating with server-side Apex and Salesforce Data APIs.

· Implement secure, compliant solutions (field-level security, sharing model, FLS/CRUD checks, with platform encryption where applicable).

· Own integration patterns (REST/SOAP, callouts, Platform Events, Change Data Capture) and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft/Boomi/Informatica) as needed.

· Optimize performance (selective queries, bulkification, governor limits, transaction control) and improve org health via code reviews and static analysis.

· Define CI/CD pipelines (Copado/AutoRABIT/GitHub Actions), branching strategies, and automated testing (Apex tests, Jest for LWC).

· Collaborate in Scrum/Agile ceremonies, estimate work, and deliver increments; provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

· Document solution designs, sequence/data models, and deployment runbooks; support UAT and production releases with high reliability.

Requirements

· Experience in Salesforce development; strong Apex expertise designing enterprise-grade solutions.

· Hands-on with LWC, Aura, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Data Service, and Salesforce Security/sharing model.

· Experience with integration (REST/SOAP/Webhooks), middleware and eventing

· Proficiency with DevOps/CI-CD on Salesforce (Copado/AutoRABIT/Git), test automation, code quality tools (PMD, ESLint for LWC).

· Solid understanding of governor limits, bulk patterns, transaction control, and performance tuning at scale.

· Experience working in agile teams; strong communication skills in English (C1) to work with global stakeholders.

· Preferred: Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I), experience with Heroku, SSO/Security, and Unit/E2E testing frameworks

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.


⸻


The Role


As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

description:

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. title: Data Scientist \"987402\"

Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio, utilizando linguagens como Python ou R.

Realizar modelagem de dados, estruturando e preparando bases de dados para análises avançadas e para consumo por modelos estatísticos e preditivos.

Extrair, manipular e analisar dados utilizando SQL, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance nas consultas.

Avaliar, validar e monitorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, aplicando métricas estatísticas e ajustes contínuos para melhoria de resultados.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas, documentando processos, hipóteses e resultados de forma clara e acessível.


O que você precisa ter


  • Python ou R;
  • SQL;
  • Pytorch.

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.



What You Will Do



Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings



Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

Para essa nova fase, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com profissionais criativos, técnicos e orientados à qualidade e resultado.

Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da percepção de valor do produto e da marca no mercado americano.


Se você tem olhar estético apurado, ritmo, domínio técnico e entende o vídeo como ferramenta estratégica de marketing, essa vaga é para você.

  • Gravar e editar vídeos para Instagram (Reels, Stories e Feed), alinhados à estratégia de conteúdo e lançamentos;
  • Produzir versões de vídeos para anúncios pagos, respeitando formatos, durações e boas práticas de performance;
  • Editar vídeos para páginas de lançamento e vendas, garantindo clareza, narrativa e fluidez;
  • Aplicar cortes, ritmo, legendas, animações simples, trilhas e efeitos, mantendo alto padrão de qualidade;
  • Garantir consistência visual e narrativa com o posicionamento e identidade do My Catholic Library;
  • Ajustar vídeos com base em feedbacks estratégicos e de performance;
  • Acompanhar tendências de edição, formatos e linguagem audiovisual, especialmente no mercado americano.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como Editor(a) de Vídeo para redes sociais e marketing digital;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut ou similares);
  • Habilidade com edição dinâmica para formatos curtos, especialmente Reels e anúncios;
  • Conhecimento de legendagem, ritmo, storytelling visual e retenção de atenção;
  • Capacidade de interpretar briefings estratégicos e transformar em vídeos eficazes;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com prazos;
  • Mentalidade aberta a testes, ajustes e otimizações contínuas;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (para compreensão de briefings e referências internacionais).

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Product Owner
description:
Vaga: Product Owner (PO)


⸻


Sobre a posição


Buscamos um(a) Product Owner (PO) para atuar diretamente na evolução dos produtos da Wite, trabalhando em conjunto com times que utilizam Node.js, Next.js, APIs e arquiteturas modernas.


Essa posição tem papel fundamental na qualidade das entregas, sendo responsável por garantir que as demandas estejam bem analisadas, detalhadas, organizadas e quebradas em subtarefas claras, facilitando a execução do time de desenvolvimento.


Procuramos alguém com visão analítica, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de avaliar, otimizar e direcionar tarefas técnicas e funcionais, sempre alinhadas ao objetivo do produto.


É uma função prática, próxima do time técnico, com foco em execução, clareza, qualidade e redução de retrabalho.


⸻


Responsabilidades


Avaliar demandas de produto considerando o contexto técnico de aplicações em Node.js, Next.js e APIs.


Detalhar requisitos funcionais e técnicos de forma clara e objetiva.


Quebrar demandas maiores em subtarefas bem definidas, considerando backend, frontend e integrações.


Ajudar a direcionar o time técnico sobre o escopo correto e a ordem de execução das tarefas.


Organizar, atualizar e manter o backlog com alto nível de qualidade.


Apoiar o PM na priorização e refinamento das atividades.


Garantir que histórias estejam completas, claras e com critérios de aceite bem definidos.


Identificar inconsistências técnicas, riscos e pontos de melhoria antes da execução.


Acompanhar entregas para garantir aderência ao que foi definido.


Documentar regras de negócio, fluxos e decisões de produto.


Manter comunicação clara, organizada e objetiva com o time técnico e de produto.


⸻


Requisitos técnicos


Capacidade de analisar requisitos e transformá-los em histórias de usuário claras e executáveis.


Boa compreensão de aplicações web modernas baseadas em Node.js e Next.js.


Noção de funcionamento de APIs, integrações e fluxos backend e frontend.


Experiência prática com backlog, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceite.


Domínio de Jira ou ferramenta similar para organização e acompanhamento das atividades.


Capacidade de quebrar demandas técnicas e funcionais em subtarefas objetivas.


Boa organização e atenção a detalhes.


Vivência com produtos digitais e times de desenvolvimento.


⸻


Competências comportamentais


Perfil analítico e organizado.


Foco em qualidade e clareza.


Boa comunicação com times técnicos.


Proatividade para identificar melhorias e riscos.


Responsabilidade com entregas e escopo.


Postura colaborativa.


Capacidade de ouvir, analisar e direcionar.


⸻


Importante


Buscamos um PO técnico, organizado e detalhista, que entenda o contexto de Node.js, Next.js e APIs, e ajude o time a trabalhar com mais clareza, eficiência e qualidade.


Perfis superficiais ou pouco atentos a detalhes não atendem ao que buscamos.

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno Mobile Flutter (PJ)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno Mobile Flutter (PJ) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Contínua

  • Evolução do App: Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e componentes com foco em código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Ciclo de Releases Semanais: Garantir a entrega de incrementos de software funcionais e testados ao final de cada ciclo, respeitando os prazos das sprints.


2. Colaboração e Qualidade Técnica

  • Review de Código: Realizar revisões de código (Code Reviews) dos parceiros de equipe, garantindo a manutenção dos padrões técnicos, a disseminação de conhecimento e a qualidade da base de código.
  • Apoio à Liderança: Prestar suporte técnico ao Líder Técnico e ao Gerente de Produto na viabilidade de novas features, ajudando a quebrar requisitos complexos em tarefas técnicas menores e estimáveis.
  • Sintonia com Backend: Colaborar ativamente na definição e consumo dos endpoints, garantindo que a comunicação entre App e API seja performática e segura.


3. Sustentação e Suporte

  • Atendimento de Chamados: Atuar no suporte e resolução de chamados de nível técnico, identificando a causa raiz de bugs reportados e implementando correções definitivas.
  • Homologação e Testes: Testar e validar cada funcionalidade em múltiplos dispositivos, garantindo que a experiência do usuário seja consistente em Android e iOS.


4. Excelência em UI/UX e Performance

  • Garantia de Fidelidade Visual: Assegurar que o produto final seja uma cópia fiel do design proposto (Figma), mantendo a máxima qualidade estética e fluidez de navegação.
  • Otimização de Performance: Monitorar e melhorar constantemente a performance do aplicativo (tempo de resposta, consumo de bateria e memória).


5. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Técnica: Manter-se atualizado com as atualizações do ecossistema Flutter/Dart, aplicando melhorias que tornem o processo de desenvolvimento mais eficiente.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Identificar antecipadamente riscos de integração ou atrasos, propondo soluções ao time para evitar retrabalhos ou bloqueios nas entregas semanais.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Domínio de Flutter & Dart: Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações robustas para Android e iOS a partir de uma base de código única.
  • Fidelidade ao Layout (Pixel Perfect): Capacidade de transformar designs complexos (Figma) em interfaces funcionais com alta precisão, respeitando rigorosamente guias de estilo e componentes.
  • Consumo de APIs REST & Resiliência: Experiência avançada em integração com APIs, com tratamento de erros de rede, estados de loading/empty e estratégias de cache offline.
  • Gerenciamento de Estado Profissional: Domínio de soluções escaláveis como Bloc, Riverpod ou Provider, garantindo a separação clara entre lógica de negócio e UI.
  • Performance e Otimização: Habilidade em identificar e corrigir gargalos de performance (jank), otimização de imagens e gerenciamento eficiente de memória.
  • Testes e Qualidade: Experiência na escrita de testes unitários e de widgets para garantir a estabilidade das funcionalidades core durante as evoluções do app.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco em Valor: Mentalidade voltada para soluções que equilibram rapidez de entrega com robustez técnica, evitando complexidade desnecessária.
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Trabalho em sintonia fina com o desenvolvedor Backend para alinhar contratos de API e evitar retrabalhos nas integrações.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor visual e funcional; o aplicativo deve ser polido e fiel à identidade visual em diferentes tamanhos de tela.
  • Agilidade e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar com releases semanais, mantendo a cadência de entrega e a qualidade sem comprometer a estabilidade das versões anteriores.
  • Atitude de Dono (Proatividade): Identificar precocemente riscos técnicos ou inconsistências no design e propor soluções antes que se tornem bloqueios para a release.


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o \"porquê\" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Data & Security Engineer to build, maintain, and secure analytics infrastructure for a prediction market platform (Forkast). This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, on-chain analytics, and security, with a strong focus on trade activity analysis, dashboarding, and anomaly detection.

You will be responsible for transforming raw on-chain and off-chain data into actionable insights, powering Hex dashboards, Dune Analytics, and internal monitoring systems that support product decisions, risk management, and market integrity.


Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics

  • Design and maintain Hex dashboards for real-time and historical market insights.
  • Build and optimize Dune Analytics queries for on-chain trade activity, liquidity, user behavior, and market performance.
  • Analyze trade activity across prediction markets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies.
  • Develop data pipelines to ingest, clean, and normalize blockchain and application-level data.
  • Support forecasting and prediction market analytics (volume, liquidity, pricing efficiency, trader behavior).


Security & Risk

  • Monitor markets for suspicious trading behavior, manipulation, wash trading, or oracle exploitation.
  • Build alerts and dashboards for risk and security events.
  • Collaborate with protocol and smart contract teams to assess data-related security risks.
  • Ensure data integrity, access control, and best practices for sensitive analytics infrastructure.


Prediction Market Intelligence

  • Support Forkast market design with data-driven insights.
  • Analyze market resolution accuracy, trader incentives, and pricing signals.
  • Create metrics to evaluate market health and predictive performance.


Requirements:


Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with SQL (especially for Dune Analytics).
  • Hands-on experience building Dashboards in Hex (or similar BI tools).
  • Familiarity with blockchain data (Ethereum or EVM chains preferred).
  • Experience analyzing on-chain trade activity and user behavior.
  • Solid understanding of data security principles and monitoring systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, DeFi, or financial markets.
  • Knowledge of smart contracts, oracles, and on-chain risk vectors.
  • Python or similar language for data processing and automation.
  • Experience with anomaly detection or fraud analysis.
  • Familiarity with Forkast or similar platforms (Polymarket, Kalshi, etc.).


What we are looking for?

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate raw data into clear, decision-ready insights.
  • Security-conscious approach to data and infrastructure.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, crypto-native environments.
  • Proactive problem solver who can work independently.

﻿

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge prediction market technology.
  • High ownership over data and security architecture.
  • Remote-friendly, flexible working environment.
  • Opportunity to shape market integrity and analytics at scale.

  • Volume de contatos e leads atendidos

  • Receita gerada e ticket médio
  • Nível de inadimplência e tempo médio de atendimento
  • Acompanhamento da atualização e integridade do CRM

Em 3 meses:

  • Organização da área e definição de rotinas e papéis
  • Implantação e uso efetivo do CRM integrado
  • Início de melhoria nos indicadores globais de vendas
  • Confiança da equipe e aderência às novas metodologias


Em 6 meses:

  • Time operando com rotina consolidada e metas claras
  • Pós-venda estruturado e campanhas rodando em sinergia com marketing
  • Primeiras entregas de crescimento de receita e expansão da carteira


Em longo prazo:

  • Criação de squads de vendas com sublideranças
  • Automação de processos com uso de IA e BI
  • Participação ativa no planejamento estratégico comercial


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada de 3 a 5 anos na área de inside sales, com pelo menos 2 anos em posições de liderança direta ou coordenação de equipes.
  • Vivência com CRM, ERP, Pipefy e ferramentas de automação.
  • Domínio de Excel para análises e gestão de resultados
  • Experiência comprovada em estruturação de setores e desenvolvimento de equipes
  • Desejável conhecimento do setor de tecnologia, mobile ou vendas B2B consultivas
  • Inglês é considerado diferencial


Perfil comportamental esperado

  • Liderança com foco em entrega e desenvolvimento do time
  • Organização e clareza na execução de processos
  • Autonomia, proatividade e foco em solução
  • Boa comunicação e inteligência emocional
  • Disciplina, resiliência e visão de longo prazo


Cultura e ambiente de trabalho

Valorizamos a superação, a meritocracia e o trabalho em equipe. Buscamos pessoas que compartilhem nossa visão de excelência, que saibam liderar pelo exemplo e que estejam dispostas a construir algo relevante e duradouro.


Valores inegociáveis: Ética, honestidade, humildade, comprometimento, disciplina e autorresponsabilidade.


Oportunidades de crescimento

A posição oferece perspectiva de ascensão para Gerência Nacional de Inside Sales, além da possibilidade de participação no planejamento estratégico e expansão da área com novas lideranças subordinadas.

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).


This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React/Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, refinement sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Lead complex technical analyses and mentor less‑experienced developers.


Technical Requirements


  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and caching strategies for AEM.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git/GitFlow.
  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).
  • Experience with cloud environments (preferably AWS ).


Preferred Technical Competencies


  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) for cart/checkout flows.
  • Experience with microservices or event‑driven architectures.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.


Behavioral Competencies


  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.


Skill Set Summary


  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git/GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React/Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.

Commercial

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

title: Ejecutivo/a de cuentas y operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:

  • Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
  • Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
  • Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.

Competencias sociales y personales:

  • Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
  • Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
  • Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
  • Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.

Lo que ofrecemos:

  • Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia
  • Contrato local con beneficios complementarios
  • Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo
  • Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento
  • Para presentar su candidatura, envíe su CV y una carta de presentación a , especificando en qué medida su experiencia y aptitudes se ajustan a los requisitos de este puesto. Esperamos darle la bienvenida a nuestro equipo y hacer de nuestra colaboración un éxito conjunto.

description:
Vaga: Planner Jr (Comprador)
Responsável por apoiar o planejamento e a execução do desenvolvimento de produtos de sua linha, garantindo coerência entre estratégia, custo, margens e calendário. Atua como elo entre Estilo, P&D, Planejamento e PCP, sustentando decisões que assegurem o equilíbrio entre criatividade e viabilidade financeira. Contribui no controle de custos, análise de matérias-primas, programação de produtos e acompanhamento de desempenho, assegurando que as linhas atendam aos objetivos de margem, prazo e posicionamento definidos pela marca.
ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS DO CARGO
Garantir a rentabilidade das linhas de produtos sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar a programação e negociação dos produtos nos canais B2B e B2C;
Cuidar da sobra de matéria prima das suas linhas;
Controlar com o estilo as trocas de matéria prima e/ou aviamentos quando necessário;
Equilibrar preço de custo do produto com mark up das linhas;
Acompanhar a entrega do produto até o recebimento junto ao time de PCP;
Acompanhar com o estilo o calendário da marca;
Participar das aprovações de produto;
Acompanhar a venda dos seus produtos e trazer feedbacks para o Estilo;
Co-construir junto às estilistas as matérias primas e produtos a fim de chegar na estratégia;
Realizar a compra de mostruário e peças de foto bem como a compra dos insumos necessários para sua produção;
Realizar o cadastro dos produtos e matérias-prima da sua linha utilizando os sistemas da marca (Linx, SAP e Umode)
